name: whisper-chat
description: WhatsApp-like real-time chat with end-to-end encryption

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint
